title: Drought and War Push Darfur and Kordofan Toward Famine
detail: Drought combined with ongoing war is pushing Darfur and Kordofan regions toward famine conditions. The compounding crises of armed conflict and severe drought are accelerating food insecurity across the two regions, already among the hardest-hit areas of Sudan's civil war.

media.caption: Drought and conflict drive famine conditions in Darfur and Kordofan
